description: 부산광역시_주요도로 침수 정보 [roads, bridges and tunnels and flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 부산광역시. 부산시내 주요도로 침수 및 측정소 정보(14개소) 차로변 경계석쪽에 측정 수위계 설치 후 측정. Coverage: 부산광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 부산광역시. Its tags are 재난, 안전, 폭우, 재난안전. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2018-12-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
